description: Binary assertions for learn-track — journal prompts, competency tracker, behavioral rubric. Static audit of SKILL.md.
test_input: create rubric for Gate Review readiness

assertions.name: description_says_what_first
assertions.check: frontmatter description states what the skill does before its trigger phrases (KN-Stack CLAUDE.md rule 5)

assertions.name: three_modes_routed
assertions.check: routes to Journal, Progress Tracker and Rubric Generator

assertions.name: journal_has_loop_prompt
assertions.check: at least one journal prompt must surface a feedback loop
assertions.regex: At least one prompt must surface a feedback loop

assertions.name: ai_does_not_write_journal
assertions.check: the journal is the learner's to write — the AI generates prompts only
assertions.regex: do not write journal for the learner

assertions.name: tracker_levels_need_evidence
assertions.check: every tracker row carries measured evidence — the column is named "Evidence (measured)" so an impression cannot pass as evidence

assertions.name: rubric_observable_behavior
assertions.check: rubric indicators are observable behaviors, not vague understanding

assertions.name: rubric_physical_dimension
assertions.check: rubric must include a physical/empirical validation dimension
assertions.regex: At least one dimension must address physical/empirical validation

assertions.name: rubric_failure_dimension
assertions.check: rubric must include an error/failure-handling dimension
assertions.regex: At least one dimension must address error/failure handling

assertions.name: ai_never_assigns_level
assertions.check: the AI never fills Current Level; the learner scores it from measured evidence
assertions.regex: The AI never assigns Current Level

assertions.name: measurement_from_retrieval_ledger
assertions.check: evidence comes from retrieval_stats.py over the learn-teach RETRIEVAL.md when one exists

assertions.name: no_grid_on_partial_numbers
assertions.check: unreadable ledger rows block the grid until fixed
assertions.regex: Do not build the grid on partial numbers

assertions.name: unmeasured_says_so
assertions.check: dimensions without measurement say 'chưa có phép đo', never an estimate
assertions.regex: `chưa có phép đo` where none exist, never an estimate

assertions.name: flag_confident_miss_vs_self_score
assertions.check: a self-score ≥ 3 on a dimension containing a confident-but-wrong item is flagged

assertions.name: recall_is_not_physical_evidence
assertions.check: recall numbers never count as physical/practical validation evidence

assertions.name: snapshot_not_trend
assertions.check: one retrieval_stats run is a snapshot; trends need two dated trackers
assertions.regex: Do not infer a trend from one run

assertions.name: example_uses_the_measured_grid
assertions.check: the worked example uses the same 6-column measured grid, including an unmeasured dimension and a flagged self-score
assertions.regex: Evidence \(measured\) \| Current Level \(learner\)[\s\S]{0,900}chưa có phép đo
